sql:
SELECT player_id, player_name, SUM(points) AS total_points
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_player_game_facts"
WHERE CAST(game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '4%'
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM game_date) = 2016
  AND participated = true
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1

sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.game_id) AS playoff_wins
FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."local_team_game_facts" f
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" t
  ON f.team_id = t.team_id
WHERE LOWER(t.city) LIKE '%san antonio%'
  AND LOWER(t.team_nickname) LIKE '%spurs%'
  AND CAST(f.game_id AS VARCHAR) LIKE '4%'
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM f.game_date) = 2014
  AND f.team_won = true
